message.content: Okay, I need to send a quick email to my daughter, Leila. She’s supposed to pick me up from the train station when I get back from Nice, but I haven’t confirmed the exact arrival time yet. Can you draft something polite but direct?

"Hi Leila, I’m writing to check on our plans for my return. I’ll be back from Nice this weekend. Could you let me know what time you think you’ll be at the station? I want to make sure I’m ready to meet you. Love, Mom."

Understood. Here is a warmer version:

"Hi Leila! Just checking in about your pickup. When do you think you’ll arrive at the station? Let me know so I can be ready. Love, Mom."
